findings.title: `end if` in the embed view is invalid ERB/Ruby
findings.description: The closing tag of the header conditional is written as `<%- end if %>`. `end if` is not valid Ruby, so the template fails to compile whenever `EmbedController#best` renders a topic. The block is already closed by the `if`/`else` on lines 2–4, so the trailing `if` should simply be `<%- end %>`.

findings.title: Controller spec name says 404, but the assertion and code path do not match
findings.description: The example "is 404 without an embed_url" only asserts `response.should_not be_success`. The controller calls `params.require(:embed_url)`, which raises `ActionController::ParameterMissing` and yields a 400, not a 404. Either the name or the expectation should be corrected so they describe the same behavior.

findings.title: Disqus import drops `created_at` and the `--category` option without replacement
findings.description: The change to `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])` removes the previous `created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at])` argument, so imported posts no longer keep their original dates. The `method_option :category` declaration and the `category_id` lookup are also removed, so any user who passes `-c` will now get an unknown-option error or a silently ignored value. The diff does not show either behavior change being intentional or documented.

findings.title: `TopicEmbed.import` mutates the caller's `contents` string
findings.description: `contents << "\n<hr>..."` appends to the string passed in by the caller. Any caller that reuses that string will see the footer appended. The current callers pass a fresh string, so this is not a bug today, but it is an unexpected side effect for a method named `import`.
